description: A React functional component named ChartWidget that serves as a container for dashboard chart or KPI analytics visualizations. It accepts props for title, children content (the chart or placeholder), and optional configuration options. The component renders styled div elements with conditional rendering for the children and includes comments about optional debugging features.

methods.name: ChartWidget({ title, children, options })
methods.description: React functional component for rendering a styled container with a title, optional chart content, and a placeholder message.
